_about: Decision rules for automatic confirmation (knowledge/print-wiki-merge.md, Measurement), read by p13_review.py. Two rules: rule classes of the fields, measured on the complete objects of the frozen review sample, and routes of the concordance, measured on the claim sheet of the blind samples. A class is a rule or route bound to one volume (name@volume) and may confirm only there. Only the classes listed as admissible may confirm; p13_review.py --fix-rule fixes them before any decision or answer, as the classes with at least minExpectedJudged values (claims) expected in the sample, and records the code they were fixed on; when that code changes, the rule is invalidated until the classes are fixed again. A class confirms only with at least minJudgedObjects judged objects (entries) and at least ceil(ln(alpha / m) / ln(threshold)) judged values, m the admissible classes of its rule: with fewer, even zero observed errors cannot carry the exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower bound above the threshold at the strictest Holm level. Its p-value is the larger of the exact binomial tail at the threshold and the bootstrap that resamples objects (entries) within strata, one-sided, with Holm's correction at level alpha over the admissible classes of its rule. While a threshold is null nothing confirms.

fields.thresholdReason: operator decision: no automatic confirmation in this phase; every confirmation is a person's
fields.minJudgedObjectsReason: a floor of independent objects under the minimum sample of values, because values of one object are not independent and an error-free class gives the bootstrap no variance to see; a floor, not a power calculation, which the operator may raise
